objective: Test whether one calibrated nonlinear model using Binance Futures displayed top-five L2 flow can route a causal Bybit BTCUSDT external-liquidity sweep into acceptance continuation, rejection reversal, or no trade with enough structural expected value to clear a frozen 24-bp execution contract.
non_overlap: The primary information unit is cross-venue displayed L2 additions and withdrawals around a Bybit sweep. It is not same-venue L2 cancel/refill taker alpha, price-only cross-venue latency, cross-venue open-interest breadth, iceberg inference, passive maker execution, or direction-neutral movement-hazard OCO.
decision: Hard-valid negative. Model AUC 0.5060 was below the structural-distance baseline 0.5596; only two cost-qualified actions occurred and both lost at 12/18/24bp. Retire the exact dependency without adjacent tuning.
